name: city-qoti
description: A cozy two-player town builder for the browser.

scripts.build: npm run gen && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.e2e: npm run gen && playwright test -c apps/client/playwright.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run gen && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.bench: npm run gen && npm run bench -w @qoti/bench
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @qoti/server
